# Keka | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Human Rights pay in India | The main link to validate HR India's remuneration is “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Working hours and utilization of IT services | The main link to validate the working hours and utilization of IT service items is “the entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - the self-help of staff managers - the entry of results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Rapid recruitment and entry | Rapid recruitment and onboarding is verified using the main link “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - staff manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Performance and staff interaction | Main link validation of performance and employee interaction is used as “person or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - staff manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
